Hasbele privacy policy

Last updated: 13 November 2026

Data controller: Virata. Contact: virata.software@gmail.com

Hasbele is a free app made for charity. It needs no account and does not ask for your name, e-mail address or location. We run no server of our own.

Data that stays on your device: Your counts, dhikrs, daily history, your place in the muezzin guide and your settings are kept only on your device and are not sent to us. If Android backup is turned on, they may be included in the backup in your own Google account. To delete them, clear the app data or uninstall the app.

Ads: The app can show small native ad cards from Google AdMob. Ads appear only on the Dhikrs, Muezzin home (prayer-time list), History and Settings screens. They never appear on the tasbih counter screen, during the step-by-step muezzin guide, or on the About and first-run screens, and no ad is requested there. Ads are always non-personalised.

Data involved: Ads are shown only if you give consent. While ads are on, the Google Mobile Ads SDK automatically collects the following and sends it to Google to show and measure ads and to fight fraud: your IP address, which may be used to estimate your general location; interactions such as app launches and taps; diagnostic information such as app launch time; identifiers such as the Android advertising ID and app set ID. This data is encrypted in transit. Google handles and keeps it under its own rules at https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites

Legal basis and transfers abroad: This data is processed on the basis of your explicit consent (Turkish KVKK art. 5/1). The recipient is Google; the data is collected automatically by the ad SDK. Because Google's servers are outside Türkiye, the data is transferred abroad under KVKK art. 9; this transfer also rests on your explicit consent. If you do not consent, no ads are shown, the ad SDK is never started and every feature of the app works the same.

Retention: This data does not reach us and the app does not keep it. Google's retention periods are described at the link above. The moment you gave consent is stored only on your device and is deleted when you withdraw consent.

Ratings: The History screen may show the Google Play rating window. Your rating and review go straight to Google Play and do not reach us.

Your rights: Under KVKK art. 11 you have the right to learn whether your data is processed, to request information about it, to learn its purpose and recipients, to have it corrected or deleted, to object and to claim compensation. Send requests by e-mail to virata.software@gmail.com; they are answered within 30 days. Users in the European Economic Area and the United Kingdom may also complain to the data protection authority in their country.

Changing your choices: You can turn ads on or off at any time under Ad preference in Settings; turning them off withdraws your consent and ad requests stop. In the European Economic Area and the United Kingdom, Google's consent form is shown as well, and you can change your choice under Privacy options in Settings. You can reset or delete your advertising ID in your device settings.

Children: The app is not directed at children.

Changes: Changes to this policy are published and the date above is updated.

Hasbele is a free app made as charity. It counts dhikr and the tesbihat after prayer, and shows the muezzin\'s duties for each prayer step by step.

Choose the prayer from the minaret icon or the menu. Each step tells you what to do and shows the text to read in Arabic, with its Turkish reading and, for short texts, its meaning. In the tesbihat step the tesbih counter opens from zero; when you finish, you return to the flow. The guide\'s religious texts and instructions are in Turkish.

This app is not an official app of the Presidency of Religious Affairs of Türkiye (Diyanet). Its religious content is prepared on the basis of Diyanet publications. The tesbihat counts follow the fatwa of Diyanet\'s High Board of Religious Affairs; the muezzin flows follow Diyanet\'s İslam İlmihali and Namaz İlmihali, its Religious Services Application Circular and the Hitabet ve Mesleki Uygulama course of the Ministry of National Education. The source of every text is written under it. If you notice a mistake, please write to us.

If you consent, a few small Google AdMob ads appear on the Zikirs, muezzin prayer list, History and Settings screens; never on the tesbih counter or in the step-by-step muezzin flow. To do this, the Google Mobile Ads SDK automatically sends your IP address, Android advertising ID, app set ID, interaction and diagnostic information to Google to show and measure ads and to fight fraud. Google processes this data on its servers abroad. Ads are never personalised. Your counts are not part of this; they stay on your phone.

You can write to us to use your data protection rights. Details are in the privacy policy on the About page.
